body:
CHANGELOG updated in BRAWLPIT: S451: added a regression guard for MAIN's live PPO model -- if a generation's evaluated Elo drops >=100 below MAIN's own best-ever, the live model reverts to that best checkpoint instead of compounding the regression (new _should_revert_main(), 6 new tests). Diagnosed a real, directly-observed Elo spike-then-collapse (1800 Elo with real movement, then reverted to dormant) as classic PPO catastrophic forgetting in self-play. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
